nodes.description: Public address state variable holding the contract owner; set to msg.sender in the constructor and used as the recipient of owner.transfer and selfdestruct.
Mapping(address => uint) of pending payouts. Read, zeroed and credited with unchecked += arithmetic.
Current round counter; incremented with ++ and used to index the participants mapping.
Mapping(uint => address[3]) storing round participants; entries are overwritten in userRegister.
Constructor: sets owner = msg.sender and initializes round = 1 and participants[1][0].
Owner-only function guarded by whenOwner that transfers an arbitrary amount to owner.
Owner-only function that calls selfdestruct(owner).
View getter returning the current round value.
View getter returning participants[index] for a caller-supplied index.
View getter returning withdrawals[player] for a caller-supplied address.
Public withdrawal function: requires a non-zero balance, zeroes the balance, then transfers to msg.sender and emits Log.
Payable public entry point that registers msg.sender, computes a pseudo-random winner from blockhash, credits a reward and advances the round.
Caller-controlled address used as owner, participant, reward recipient, transfer recipient and withdrawal key.
owner.transfer(amount) external value transfer executed in ownerWithdraw.
selfdestruct(owner) irreversible state destruction executed in ownerDestroy.
msg.sender.transfer(amount) external call performed in userWithdraw after state is zeroed.
Pseudo-random value derived from blockhash(block.number - 1) plus participant addresses; miner-influenceable.
Unchecked mapping addition withdrawals[participants[round][x]] += reward (arithmetic).
amount parameter of ownerWithdraw used as the transfer value.
index parameter of publicGetParticipants used to index the participants mapping.
player parameter of publicGetBalance used to index the withdrawals mapping.
local amount in userWithdraw cached from withdrawals[msg.sender] before being transferred.
local reward constant (100 finney) added to the winner's withdrawals entry.
local random value in userRegister used to pick the round winner via parity.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
Caller-controlled msg.sender is stored into the owner state variable.
whenOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before ownerWithdraw runs.
whenOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before ownerDestroy runs.
ownerWithdraw executes owner.transfer(amount).
owner address is the recipient of the value transfer.
amount parameter is passed as the transfer value.
ownerDestroy invokes selfdestruct.
owner address is the beneficiary of selfdestruct.
publicGetRound returns the round state variable.
publicGetParticipants reads the participants mapping.
publicGetBalance reads the withdrawals mapping.
userWithdraw keys the withdrawals balance on msg.sender.
withdrawals entry is read then zeroed in userWithdraw.
userWithdraw performs the external msg.sender.transfer call.
Transfer amount originates from the withdrawals mapping.
Local amount variable is the value sent by transfer.
External call to caller-controlled msg.sender can re-enter contract functions from the fallback.
userRegister depends on caller-supplied msg.sender/msg.value.
userRegister writes participants[round][1] = msg.sender.
Participant addresses are converted to uint and mixed into the random value.
msg.sender (as participant) influences the computed random value.
userRegister computes random from blockhash(block.number - 1).
Parity of random selects which withdrawals entry receives the unchecked addition.
userRegister executes the unchecked withdrawals balance addition.
withdrawals mapping is updated with an unchecked += that can overflow.
reward local variable is added to the winner's withdrawals entry.
userRegister increments round with ++ (unchecked arithmetic).

normalization_plan.reason: The amount parameter exists only to supply the value of owner.transfer(amount); it can be folded into that unsafe operation.
The index parameter is only used to select the participants mapping slot returned by publicGetParticipants.
The player parameter is only used to key the withdrawals mapping lookup performed by publicGetBalance.
The local amount is a temporary copy of the withdrawals entry fed directly into msg.sender.transfer.
The local reward constant is used only as the right-hand operand of the unchecked withdrawals += operation.
The local random value is the direct result of the blockhash-based randomness computation.
